Newsletter Writers: how this community works

A community for independent newsletter writers.

  1. Cross-posting from your newsletter platform with automation is allowed.
  2. Links to your own newsletter are welcome; that is what this community is for.
  3. Do not use link shorteners, so readers can see where a link goes.
  4. Limit: 1 post per week per publication.
